links.outcome: Expert Likert ratings of accuracy, completeness, consistency, and safety: retrieval-augmented ChatVTE vs ChatGPT
links.effect: ChatVTE outperformed ChatGPT on accuracy, completeness, consistency (all P<.001, r>0.5) and safety (P=.01, r=0.327). The comparison is confounded, since the two systems differ in model as well as retrieval.
links.quote: Expert evaluation demonstrated that ChatVTE significantly outperformed ChatGPT in accuracy, completeness, consistency (all P<.001, r>0.5), and safety (P=.01, r=0.327).

unlisted_practices: Embedding a text-to-speech and lip-synch avatar interface in an LLM patient education tool to promote engagement

screen.reason: Prospective cohort study deploying an interactive LLM-based patient education system (ChatVTE) with 25 hospitalized VTE patients, assessing patient experience and expert-evaluated safety/accuracy.
